variables.name: Air temperature
variables.definition: The average air temperature two meters above the ground.
variables.power_definition: The average air (dry bulb) temperature at 2 meters above the surface of the earth.
variables.notes: Annual values are the unweighted mean of 12 complete monthly means; years crossing product boundaries are excluded.

variables.name: Monthly high temperature
variables.definition: The highest hourly air temperature in each month, measured two meters above the surface.
variables.power_definition: The maximum hourly air (dry bulb) temperature at 2 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.
variables.notes: Annual values are the unweighted mean of 12 complete monthly means; years crossing product boundaries are excluded.

variables.name: Monthly low temperature
variables.definition: The lowest hourly air temperature in each month, measured two meters above the surface.
variables.power_definition: The minimum hourly air (dry bulb) temperature at 2 meters above the surface of the earth in the period of interest.
variables.notes: Annual values are the unweighted mean of 12 complete monthly means; years crossing product boundaries are excluded.

variables.name: Surface temperature
variables.definition: The temperature of the surface itself, rather than the air above it.
variables.power_definition: The average temperature at the earth's surface.
variables.notes: Annual values are the unweighted mean of 12 complete monthly means; years crossing product boundaries are excluded.

variables.name: Precipitation
variables.definition: The average water falling as rain and snow each day, with a correction for measurement bias.
variables.power_definition: The average MERRA-2 bias corrected total precipitation at the surface of the earth.
variables.notes: Annual values are the unweighted mean of 12 complete monthly means; years crossing product boundaries are excluded.

variables.name: Land evaporation
variables.definition: The water that returns to the air from land and plants each day.
variables.power_definition: The evaporation over land at the surface of the earth.
variables.notes: All monthly values at the open-ocean test point are fill. Annual values are the unweighted mean of 12 complete monthly means; years crossing product boundaries are excluded.

variables.name: Topsoil wetness
variables.definition: How wet the upper soil layer is, from zero for dry to one for saturated.
variables.power_definition: The amount of water and water vapor present in the soil. Top indicates the upper 5 cm of soil. Values range from 0 for completely dry conditions to 1 for completely saturated soil.
variables.notes: The ocean test returns constant 1 rather than fill; this is a soil variable and ocean values must not be interpreted. Annual values are the unweighted mean of 12 complete monthly means; years crossing product boundaries are excluded.

variables.name: Root-zone wetness
variables.definition: How wet the soil around plant roots is, from zero for dry to one for saturated.
variables.power_definition: The amount of water and water vapor available to plants in the root zone, generally considered to be the upper 1 m of soil, expressed as the proportion of water present in a given amount of soil. Values range from 0 for completely dry conditions to 1 for completely saturated soil.
variables.notes: All monthly values at the open-ocean test point are fill. Annual values are the unweighted mean of 12 complete monthly means; years crossing product boundaries are excluded.

variables.name: Snow depth
variables.definition: The depth of snow covering the land surface.
variables.power_definition: The snow depth on land at surface of the earth.
variables.notes: All monthly values at the open-ocean test point are fill. Annual values are the unweighted mean of 12 complete monthly means; years crossing product boundaries are excluded.

variables.name: Relative humidity
variables.definition: The water vapor in the air as a percentage of what it could hold at that temperature.
variables.power_definition: The ratio of vapor pressure to the saturation vapor pressure with respect to a plane surface of pure water, expressed in percent.
variables.notes: Annual values are the unweighted mean of 12 complete monthly means; years crossing product boundaries are excluded.

variables.name: Specific humidity
variables.definition: The mass of water vapor in each kilogram of air two meters above the ground.
variables.power_definition: The ratio of the mass of water vapor to the total mass of air at 2 meters.
variables.notes: Annual values are the unweighted mean of 12 complete monthly means; years crossing product boundaries are excluded.

variables.name: Sunlight at the surface
variables.definition: The solar energy reaching the surface each day, including the effect of clouds.
variables.power_definition: The total solar irradiance incident (direct plus diffuse) on a horizontal plane at the surface of the earth under all sky conditions. An alternative term for the total solar irradiance is the "Global Horizontal Irradiance" or GHI.
variables.notes: Annual values are the unweighted mean of 12 complete monthly means; years crossing product boundaries are excluded.

variables.name: Cloud cover
variables.definition: The percentage of the sky covered by clouds.
variables.power_definition: The average percent of cloud amount during the temporal period.
variables.notes: Annual values are the unweighted mean of 12 complete monthly means; years crossing product boundaries are excluded.

messages: Please provide at least on meteorology parameter for times prior to 1984-1-1; radiation parameters are not available until 1984-1-1. The request would return no data.

variables.name: Wind speed
variables.definition: How fast the wind blows two meters above the ground.
variables.power_definition: The average of wind speed at 2 meters above the surface of the earth.
variables.notes: Annual values are the unweighted mean of 12 complete monthly means; years crossing product boundaries are excluded.

variables.name: Aerosol optical depth
variables.definition: How much airborne dust, smoke, and other particles weaken light at a wavelength of 550 nanometers.
variables.power_definition: The optical thickness at 0.55 um measured vertically; the component of the atmosphere to quantify the removal of radiant energy from an incident beam.
variables.notes: Annual values are the unweighted mean of 12 complete monthly means; years crossing product boundaries are excluded.
